snippet.title: DIVE OR DIE - CHILDREN OF RAIN | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Every descent is a deadly gamble in this 2D Lovecraftian underwater roguelite.
DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.
Whislist our game on steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590290/DIVE_or_DIE__Children_of_Rain/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
